title: Bring a spring cord reel's work light home into its dock
instruction: Let the cord reel wind its cord back in and put the yellow work light into the grey dock in front of the reel, then let go of the light.
context: Retractable cord reels wind their cord back with a spring under tension. A retractable cord reel owner's manual warns: "Do not allow the cord to retract without restraining the recoil speed. Never let go of the cord when rewinding." (Owner's Manual & Safety Instructions, models 72520/72522: images.homedepot-static.com/catalog/pdfImages/c7/c7f34c7f-cef5-4f7c-be8e-5bf360f815df.pdf).
setup: Station table; cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left). Reel: red 9 x 36 x 6 cm housing along y at x 42, its right face at y 29 with a 12 x 16 mm cord slot at table level; cord: black 5 mm round rubber cord, 34 cm out, lying straight along x 42 to the light. Work light: yellow 200 x 30 x 20 mm bar (25 g) on the cord end, lying from y -5 (cord end) to y -25 against a grey parking stop (two 15 x 10 x 10 mm blocks either side of the cord at y -4.3). Dock: two grey rails 5 mm wide, 6 mm tall, 8.5 cm long, 40 mm apart inside, either side of x 42 from y 8.5 to y 17 (the 12 cm next to the reel face are open). Reel pull ~1 N with the cord out, ~0.5 N near home.
scoring: Score 0 if: while more than 2 cm of cord is out, the reel ever draws it in faster than 25 cm/s, or the cord moves faster than 3 cm/s either way while no closed gripper holds the light (gripper centre within 3 cm of its centre line); at the end a gripper is within 3 cm of the light or cord; at the end more than 2 cm of cord is out. Otherwise, at the end: 1.0 if the light lies in the dock between the rails, cord end within 1 cm of the reel face, axis within 10 deg of the dock line, still 1 s; 0.5 if both grippers held the light at the same moment and the cord is wound in (at most 2 cm out) but the light is not seated in the dock; 0 if the light was never held by both grippers and is not seated.
reset_notes: Pull the light out by hand to the parking stop (cord end at y -5 cm) and lay it straight along the x 42 cm line against the stop; check the cord runs straight from the reel slot to the light.
fidelity: Cord: 2 cm rigid segments with bending springs, no twist. The reel spool is replaced by a straight spring track inside the housing (1.4 N/m spring, ~1 N out, ~0.5 N home); a real reel gives a near-constant pull. The light is a rigid box. Holding is judged from finger closure and gripper position (video in real trials); retraction speed from the cord at the slot. A light set down slanted beside the rails at the slot stays there, held by friction (0.5).
